source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 17: Cleft Sentences

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ.
challenge.distractor_strategy: near_correct — sai ở chi tiết nhỏ

starter.stem: ___ is poverty that causes the most suffering in developing nations.
starter.explanation_short: It-cleft: It is/was + focus + that + clause.
starter.explanation_long: It-cleft: It is X that Y. Nhấn mạnh X.
starter.ielts_tip: It is/was + X + that = cleft sentence.

starter.stem: ___ the world needs is a united effort to fight poverty.
starter.explanation_short: What-cleft: What + S + V + is + focus.
starter.explanation_long: What-cleft: What the world needs is X. Nhấn mạnh X.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: It (It-cleft cấu trúc khác), That (sai)

starter.stem: It ___ the lack of education that keeps communities trapped in poverty.
starter.explanation_long: It-cleft: It + is/was. 'Lack of education' = singular → is.

starter.stem: What we need ___ more international cooperation.
starter.explanation_short: What-cleft: What + S + V + is + focus.

starter.stem: It was in 2015 ___ the Paris Agreement was signed.
starter.explanation_short: It-cleft: It was + time + THAT (không when).
starter.explanation_long: It-cleft luôn dùng 'that', ngay cả khi nhấn mạnh thời gian. Không dùng when.

starter.stem: It is ___ that has the greatest impact on children's futures.
starter.explanation_short: It is + noun (focus) + that: It is education that...
starter.explanation_long: It-cleft: It is + noun/noun phrase + that.

starter.stem: What concerns experts most ___ the rising inequality gap.
It was the government ___ failed to address the housing crisis.
starter.explanation_long: It-cleft luôn dùng 'that', ngay cả khi nhấn mạnh người.
starter.ielts_tip: It-cleft: that cho mọi trường hợp.

starter.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'It is the lack of resources what prevents progress in developing countries.'
starter.explanation_short: It-cleft: It is + focus + THAT (không what).
starter.explanation_long: It-cleft luôn dùng 'that'. 'What' dùng trong What-cleft.
starter.feedback_wrong: It is... that. KHÔNG It is... what.

starter.stem: ___ is needed to solve global issues is strong leadership.
starter.explanation_short: What-cleft: What is needed is X.

build_up.stem: It is access to clean water ___ can transform communities in developing regions.
build_up.explanation_long: It-cleft: It is access to clean water THAT can transform...
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: which (relative clause, nhưng đây là cleft)

build_up.stem: What makes this crisis particularly devastating ___ its impact on the most vulnerable populations.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: are (nếu nghĩ populations = plural → sai, vì What = singular subject)

build_up.stem: It was not until 2020 ___ the government took serious action against pollution.
build_up.explanation_short: It was not until + time + THAT.
build_up.explanation_long: It was not until + time/event + that + S + V. Cấu trúc nhấn mạnh.
build_up.ielts_tip: It was not until... that = chỉ khi... mới...
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: when (thời gian nhưng cleft dùng that)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'What the country needs are better healthcare systems and education.'
options: Câu đúng — are đúng vì focus là plural (systems and education)
build_up.correct_answer: Câu đúng — are đúng vì focus là plural (systems and education)
build_up.explanation_short: What + S + V + are + plural focus. Khi focus = plural → are OK.
build_up.explanation_long: Khi phần focus sau is/are là plural → dùng 'are'. 'Systems and education' = plural → are.
build_up.feedback_wrong: What... is + singular. What... are + plural.
build_up.ielts_tip: Focus plural → are. Focus singular → is.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option B (is) cũng đúng theo một số quy tắc)

build_up.stem: It is only through international cooperation ___ we can address the global refugee crisis.
build_up.explanation_short: It is only through + noun + THAT.
build_up.explanation_long: It-cleft: It is only through + focus + that + S + V.
build_up.ielts_tip: It is only by/through... that = nhấn mạnh cách thức.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'It is the poverty what prevents millions of children from attending school.'
build_up.explanation_short: It-cleft: that (không what). It is X THAT Y.
build_up.explanation_long: It-cleft luôn dùng 'that'. 'What' chỉ dùng trong What-cleft.
build_up.feedback_wrong: It is... that. KHÔNG It is... what.

build_up.stem: What distinguishes successful nations from others ___ their investment in human capital.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: are (nghĩ nations = plural → sai, What = subject)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'What is needed to solve this crisis are strong leadership and international cooperation.'
options: Câu đúng — are đúng vì focus plural
build_up.correct_answer: Câu đúng — are đúng vì focus plural
build_up.explanation_short: Focus = plural (leadership and cooperation) → are OK.
build_up.explanation_long: Khi focus = compound/plural → 'are' có thể dùng.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option B (is cũng được theo formal grammar)

build_up.stem: It was the 2008 financial crisis ___ exposed the vulnerability of the global economic system.
build_up.explanation_long: It-cleft: It was the 2008 crisis THAT exposed...

build_up.stem: What the research reveals ___ that income inequality leads to social instability.
build_up.explanation_short: What-cleft: What + S + V + is + that-clause.
build_up.explanation_long: What the research reveals (singular) → is. Followed by that-clause.
build_up.ielts_tip: What-cleft with that-clause: What... is that...

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'It is the lack of education what prevents developing countries from achieving economic growth and social stability.'
options: It is the lack of education
challenge.explanation_short: It-cleft: that (không what). It is X THAT Y.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'what' → 'that' (It-cleft luôn dùng that, không what). Lớp 2: 'It is the lack of education THAT prevents' = đúng.
challenge.feedback_wrong: It is... that. KHÔNG It is... what.

challenge.stem: Chọn câu Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT dùng cleft sentence:
options: It is education that plays the most crucial role in reducing global poverty and promoting sustainable development.
It is education what plays the most crucial role in reducing poverty.
What plays the most crucial role in reducing poverty is education that helps.
Education that is what plays the most crucial role.
challenge.correct_answer: It is education that plays the most crucial role in reducing global poverty and promoting sustainable development.
challenge.explanation_short: It-cleft chuẩn: It is + focus + that + V.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'It is education that plays' = It-cleft chuẩn. Lớp 2: Option B dùng 'what'. Lớp 3: Option C trộn What-cleft + that. Lớp 4: Option D cấu trúc sai.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 It is education that plays = chuẩn!
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B dùng what thay that

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'What the developing world need most are sustainable solutions that address both poverty and environmental degradation.'
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'the developing world' = singular → 'needs' (không 'need'). Lớp 2: 'are' có thể đúng vì focus = plural (sustainable solutions). Nhưng lỗi rõ nhất là 'need'.

challenge.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT phân biệt It-cleft và What-cleft:
options: It is education that matters most. / What matters most is education.
What is education that matters most. / It matters most is education.
It is education what matters. / What matters most that education.
Education is what matters. / What it matters is education.
challenge.correct_answer: It is education that matters most. / What matters most is education.
challenge.explanation_short: It-cleft: It is X that Y. What-cleft: What Y is X.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: It-cleft: 'It is education that matters' = đúng. Lớp 2: What-cleft: 'What matters most is education' = đúng. Lớp 3: Cả hai cách đều nhấn mạnh 'education'.
challenge.feedback_wrong: It-cleft: It is X that. What-cleft: What... is X.
challenge.ielts_tip: It-cleft vs What-cleft: 2 cách nhấn mạnh.

options: It is through education that we can break the cycle of poverty.
It is through education what we can break the cycle of poverty.
It is through education which we can break the cycle of poverty.
It was through education when we can break the cycle of poverty.
challenge.correct_answer: It is through education that we can break the cycle of poverty.
challenge.explanation_short: It-cleft: It is through + noun + THAT.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'It is through education THAT' = It-cleft chuẩn. Lớp 2: Option B dùng 'what'. Option C dùng 'which'. Option D dùng 'when' + trộn was/can.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B (what) phổ biến nhưng sai

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'What is needed to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals are commitment from all nations, which the UN has been advocating for decades.'
options: which the UN has been advocating for decades
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'commitment' = uncountable/singular → 'is' (không 'are'). Lớp 2: Nếu focus là plural → are OK, nhưng 'commitment' = singular → is.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D trông có vẻ sai nhưng đúng

challenge.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT dùng cleft:
options: It is not until governments invest in education that real progress can be made in reducing global poverty.
It is not until governments invest in education what real progress can be made.
It was not until governments invest in education that progress can be made.
it is that progress can be made.
challenge.correct_answer: It is not until governments invest in education that real progress can be made in reducing global poverty.
challenge.explanation_short: It is not until + clause + THAT + clause. Formal emphasis.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'It is not until + clause + that + clause' = chuẩn formal emphasis. Lớp 2: Option B dùng 'what'. Option C trộn was + present. Option D cấu trúc sai.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 It is not until... that = chuẩn formal!
challenge.ielts_tip: It is not until... that = formal emphasis.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'It were the failure of leadership that led to the humanitarian crisis, which affected millions of innocent civilians.'
options: It were the failure of leadership
that led to the humanitarian crisis
challenge.correct_answer: It were the failure of leadership
challenge.explanation_short: It IS/WAS (singular): It was (không It were).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'It' luôn đi với 'is/was' (không 'were'). 'It were' = sai. Lớp 2: 'It was the failure' = đúng.

challenge.stem: Speaking Part 3: 'Yếu tố nào quan trọng nhất để giảm nghèo?' — Chọn câu CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: I think it is education that plays the most crucial role in breaking the cycle of poverty.
What I think plays the most crucial role is education that helps people.
I think education what is the most important factor.
It is I think education that plays the most role.
challenge.correct_answer: I think it is education that plays the most crucial role in breaking the cycle of poverty.
challenge.explanation_short: I think + It-cleft = opinion + emphasis chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'I think' + 'It is education that' = opinion + It-cleft emphasis. Lớp 2: 'Breaking the cycle of poverty' = idiomatic expression. Lớp 3: Option B: awkward structure. Option C: 'what' sai. Option D: wrong word order.
challenge.feedback_wrong: I think/believe + It is + focus + that.
challenge.ielts_tip: Speaking: I think + cleft = opinion + emphasis.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B awkward but close

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'[A] It are education and healthcare what [B] plays the most important roles, and [C] what is needed most are strong commitment from all governments worldwide.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A] It are → It is + what → that. [B] plays → play (plural). [C] are → is (commitment = singular).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] 'It are' → 'It is' (It luôn singular). + 'what' → 'that' (It-cleft dùng that). Lớp 2: [B] 'plays' → 'play' (education and healthcare = plural). Lớp 3: [C] 'are' → 'is' ('strong commitment' = singular/uncountable).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] It is... that | [B] play | [C] is!
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A] It is + that. [B] plural → play. [C] singular → is.
challenge.ielts_tip: It-cleft: It is... that. Subject-verb agreement.
